cands.name: Jimmy Dixon
cands.bio: James William Dixon, a Republican farmer from Warsaw, has represented North Carolina House District 4 (Duplin and Wayne counties) since 2011. He graduated from Wake Forest University in 1969. He ran unsuccessfully for Duplin County Commissioner in 2008 as a Democrat.
cands.gaps: The only source available for this profile was a general encyclopedia entry. It had no information on his specific actions or stated positions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, campaign finance, policing, guns, abortion or school choice. No documented controversies, foreign ties or endorsements were found. His work history beyond farming, and when he began farming, were not found. Whether he has family or other ties outside North Carolina was not found.

cands.name: Vernon Moore
cands.bio: Vernon Moore is a Democratic candidate for North Carolina House District 4. He served in the U.S. Air Force during the Vietnam War and worked as a financial consultant with Merrill Lynch. He has run unsuccessfully for the State Senate (2018, 2020) and the State House (2024, 2026).

endorsements.text: For 2026, Ballotpedia lists recommendations from three Sway voting groups: Bull City Anna's Voting Group, Imani's Pix, and Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy.
